reviewFindings: U9CJ content durability must resolve before logical catalog publication
U9CQ decoded bootstrap content must be owned and retained once per digest

behavior: A content rename whose parent directory cannot be synced does not publish a logical asset.
A retry against the existing digest blob must also sync that directory and remains unpublished until durability succeeds.
Durable candidate reconstruction decodes content once per digest.
Memory bootstrap owns one byte copy per digest, validates identical media once, and releases bootstrap references after indexing while preserving copy-on-read output.
